description: Top live rates from MonitorBankRates.com for one product (CDs by term, savings, money market, checking, mortgages, refinance, home equity, auto loans, personal loans, credit cards), nationally, for one U.S. state, or for a city (local branches first). Returns one best quote per institution with the institution health grade, minimum deposit, as-of date, and a link. Use list_rate_keys to see valid product_key values (e.g. "12-month", "high-yield_savings", "30-year", "refinance-30-year", "new-auto").

city.description: Optional city name (needs state), e.g. Norwalk. Institutions with a branch in that city come first, flagged local, with up to 3 branch addresses there; the rest of the list is filled from the state.

min_deposit.description: Deposits only: exclude products whose minimum deposit is above this dollar amount.

product_key.description: Rate key from list_rate_keys, for example 12-month, high-yield_savings, 30-year, refinance-30-year, refinance-15-year, heloc, new-auto, credit-card.

state.description: Optional two-letter state code or state name. Returns institutions headquartered or with branches in that state. Omit for national.

name: get_best_rates
title: Best rates by product
